'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Michael Pistone LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Michael Pistone]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Fuck You Mike Lavelling
* '''Username:''' pistone 84
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
